8224.title: Repeated token resolution during foreground reconciliation
8224.rootCauseOneLine: Every reconciliation resolves the Expo token before checking registration freshness, and overlapping host triggers schedule a second run.

prReviews.topFinding: Cache and invalidation target the verified cause; no linked PR code was executed.

8224.proposedFix: Cache successful token resolution per controller process with token-change and token-release invalidation; preserve permission and age checks.
8224.caveats: Controller-level reproduction repeated in a second clean checkout by the same agent; no physical-device network capture. No duplicate fix because PR #8225 is open.
